CMR North

By: Sasha Schwendenwein | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
8 Fathers wrongfully accused of sexual assault and rape of their children. Most acquitted but one is in jail for life. At the centre of this drama is a social worker from the CMRN.

Unique Selling Point:
We have an exclusive with CMRN regarding their investigations into the social worker at the heart of this story. We also will speak with the daughter and mother of the man who is in jail for a crime he (allegedly?) did not commit.

Summary:
Willem Abram Raaths was charged of the rape of his own daughter Megan in 2010 and convicted of rape in 2012. Before sentencing but after conviction she recanted her testimony stating that the CMR North social workers involved in her matter had brainwashed and coerced her into testifying against her father. The matter went on Appeal in 2014 before the Pretoria High Court, and The Pretoria high court set aside the convictions and sentence, however the matter went back to the trial court. Megan testified that her father did not rape her and that she was brainwashed and coerced into testifying against her father however once again Raaths was convicted: the rationale was that it was improbable that Social Workers would brainwash or coerce anyone to testify against someone that they did not even know. A forensic investigator then uncovered a further seven matters where the same social workers falsely accused other fathers of rape and molestation of their children in 6 of these cases the accused were acquitted of all charges. In the matter of the State v Gerber the CMR Social Worker was caught out having lied to the court in order to attempt to obtain a conviction of the accused however their was a recording presented to the court of a social interaction analysis which was conducted by the said social worker between the child and her father in the social interaction analysis a recording was taken where the child identified someone other than her father as the perpetrator however the CMR North social worker failed to take this into account and tried to lie to the court by stating that the child did not identify the other person however when confronted with this evidence the social worker refused to answer stating that she would not incriminate herself.




Further information:
In the matter of the state v Basil Jenkins in a Pretoria High Court Judgement the court stated that the coaching of the child witness went to far and as such the accessed ought to have been acquitted on the charges relating to this child. Once more proving the fact that CMR social Workers coach children to testify against their parents.

The Department of Social Development were engaged, as they were ALREADY investigating the said social workers on numerous complaints: the resulted in the accreditation of the CMR North social workers and in a damming report which we have which recorded that these social workers may be involved in human trafficking and that all matters involving these social workers must be reviewed.
Raaths is currently sitting in Zonderwater prison – his lawyers have requested the con-court to overturn the judgement and set aside his sentence, and this decision may come in August roughly – but no one can say for sure.
There is another man also sitting in Zonderwater, Basil Jenkins whose conviction was overturned because the social worker was found to be lying. In paragraph 29 of the Judgement it is stated that The only inference that can be made is that she was trained to the extent only to remember certain things and therefore her evidence should be rejected and the accused can be acquitted on the charges relating to this witness.

Of the other 7 case studies:

Willem Raaths 2010 case,
Case was dismissed and reheard
2012 case Convicted in 2012, subsequent appeals failed
Currently at Zonderwater prison Only testimony from Megan Raaths Social Workers including Stander and dr Grabe part of CMR team Yes
Basil Jenkins 2020
Judgement overturned conviction The court of appeal found that the child was coached, and accused ought to be acquitted.
Hendrik van schalkwyk 55/08/201
? Charges formally withdrawn after report proving no sexual violation furnished to high court child returned to parents care after cmr removed from the case Stander concluded assessment, no recording of it. A second forensic assessment was done as ordered by Judge Fabricius. It concluded no sexual violation occurred.
Henrik Gerber 2011 Acquitted on all charges Matter referred to Stander by Van Schalkwyk. Concluded rape during 3, 3 hour assessment, no recording of it. The child tried to explain that someone else sexually violated her, but Stander interrupted her, and was adamant that it was her father. The session was recorded by the father. During cross-examination, this was put to stander [PG 17 typed record]. The judge was scathing of the Social Workers conduct saying she cannot assess children as she doesn’t have the qualifications. She also did not include representatives for the child during the sessions.
Jonathan Maritz 2011 Acquittal on all charges Matter referred to Stander by Van Schalkwyk. Concluded rape during 3, 3 hour assessment, no recording of it. Standers version was rejected.
Douglas ven den Heever 2019 Nolle Prosequi Only standers report
Janus Prins 2020 No charges laid due to the confrontation of the Social Worker currently in employ of CMR North Stander was confronted by the family on her initial report Oct 2020, she then revised her report, apologized to the family for making false statements about the children alleging the father raped them, and then made a new report, removing all allegations against the father. Then illegally backdated the report to Sept 2020.
?

People to interview:
1. Psychologist Lancia van der Merwe: there was no critical thinking by stander, protocols were not followed and her findings were outside of professional expertise. The HPCSA confirmed Stander is not registered as a Psychologist, and therefore cannot conduct psychometric assessments. She can’t interpret sketches made by children. Stander misled the court about her authority. Stander was found incompetent, irregular and improper.
2. Department of social development who have defunded and deregistered ?! CMR NW: Based on a report [PLEASE SEND REPORT AND POTENTIALLY CITE THEIR FINDINGS]. CMR went to court to fight the DSD : [EXPLAIN WHAT HAPPENED]

People to confront:
1. CMR NW
2. Wilna Stander
3. Margaritet Van Schalkwyk
4. Dr Susana Johanna Grabe

UPDATE: So when we spoke last we were having a conversation about motive: So this is what I've been able to establish.

The average adoption costs R40,000 according to the department, when they are meant to be free, so they feel that's an incentive in order for social workers to try take children away or pursue children and have them adopted. This is what we know Letitia did, but obviously she went further and even tried to offer multiple parents the same child. The department talks about this and confirms this in a parliamentary monitoring meeting. But we already know it.

So Dominee Daniel van Rensburg who worked with the CMR and its social workers, and he says he saw that they are paid per the cases. He wants to meet with my later and chat about this and whether he'll speak.

We know that the department and CMR have an agreement in place whereby in exchange for the CMR doing a job that the department is meant to do, they are paid per case. So obviously the more cases, the more money. We know that on average CMRN (CMR-NORTHWEST) got R7 million on average in subsidies from the government in the past three years, which has increased dramatically over the years. In 2017 it was only 3.4 million. The subsidies can be explained by the department of social development - and they said "The CMR get paid per child intake from the Department of Social Development, so while adoption is an incentive, they need to have high intake levels in order to obtain subsidies." This is why the report by SD literally says: They are looking for a family that needs a child, not a child that needs a family. Which is pretty damning. I have a leaked document from CMRs finances: staff expenses are 78% of their expenses!!! SO according to the department the motive is clear - they are upping their intakes to get more children, so that they can get more subsidies.


Extra Budget Items:
Travel to zonderwater prison as we want to interview Raaths. Its about a 2 hour drive.

Script:


For the first 8 years of her life, Megan Raaths and her father Abrie were inseparable... But this drawing of two people having sex changed everything.
Megan: I know it's not my fault because I was still young. I feel guilty because my father is sitting in jail.
Megan says she didn’t draw the picture some would later claim depicted her being raped by her father.…He was found guilty and sentenced to life in Zonderwater prison, outside Pretoria. (PAUSE) Megan is now 21.
Derek: Abrie, it's Derek Watts here from Carte Blanche. Simple question. Did you rape your daughter or molest her in any way?
Abrie: No, never. I remember going to court not even worried, I'm not guilty. The justice system will just prove that.
At first, Megan’s mother, Zwanet, believed her then husband was guilty. Now, though, she’s fighting for his release. We met her at the Pretoria office of Abrie’s lawyer.
Zwanet: Everything just went downhill after the drawing.
Did you ever suspect anything untoward between them?
No. Never.
Zwanet discovered the drawing in Megan’s school bag in 2008. Concerned, she asked the child protection organisation “CMR” - short for “Christelike Maadskaplike Raad”...to give her daughter counseling. CMR was established by Afrikaans churches as a network of social workers 85 years ago, aiming to help families in crisis. Zwanet approached the CMR North branch, which then referred Megan to a social worker in private practice called Wilna Stander. There were several counseling sessions but not one was recorded on tape.
Megan: There was this one session that was like 4 hours long without any breaks. She wanted to tell me the difference between a lie and the truth. She used the shoe and the bed as an example. And then I said what she said, the bed is a shoe, and the shoe is a bed, she told me just after that, my father had raped me.
Derek: She told you?
Megan: Yeah, after she made me confused.
That session had dramatic consequences: Zwanet was told her husband Abrie had raped their daughter. She claims to have been informed a medical exam found evidence of sex-related injuries.
Zwanet: She just told me Megan was penetrated vag​​inally and anally, and it is the father. I started throwing up, and I started screaming, and saying, ‘No, it can't be. Not Abrie!’
But Zwanet says she felt pressured into helping prosecute Abrie.
As soon as I told them every time ‘It's not the father,’ they just started, ‘Mom, if you're not supporting our case, we're going to remove her from your care.’
As the trial drew near, Zwanet alleges that the investigating police officer, a CMR social worker and Stander all told her to help Megan memorize her statements for cross-examination.
Zwanet: She's going to work with Megan through the statements that I got from Wilna. And then I must go home and prepare Megan with that. Well, I did it and today I'm very, very, very disappointed in myself that I did that. But I didn't know it was wrong.
Megan confirmed her mother’s claims, telling us she was coached on what to say in court.
Derek: Zwanet what were some of the things you had to coach her to say?
Zwanet: ‘What did he do now? He put his private inside my private’
‘And how did they feel? A bietjie seer and a bietjie lekker.’
In 2012, Abrie was found guilty and sentenced to 4 life sentences.
BUT JUST BEFORE ABRIE WAS SENTENCED – MEGAN TOTALLY RECANTED HER EVIDENCE AND SAID THAT SHE HAD NEVER BEEN RAPED BY HER FATHER
Megan: That's when I told my aunt that, ‘My father didn't do anything to me.’
As a result, Abrie was granted a second trial. But, in 2015 he was convicted again. The court accepted the evidence from the social workers who’d relied on Wilna Stander’s assessments. But it was during this trial that Zwanet stumbled upon a crucial piece of evidence: Megan’s medical report or so-called J88.. It found that all was “normal.” However, the doctor who filled in the J88 testified that it was likely that Megan had been raped.
Zwanet: When I saw the j88 that was in Abrie's file that showed ‘she's still a virgin.’ Then I was like, ‘What's going on here?’
Abrie was taken to prison. Zwanet and Megan went home to pick up the pieces. It would be 13 years before Megan saw her father again.
It was very emotional, and he was the same man that I remembered when I was little.
Abrie can’t sit down for an interview. But prisoners are allowed to get phone calls.
That first meeting was like talking to a stranger, my daughter that I left, was nine years old. She was half my size, and here comes this beautiful young lady, and she started crying, and she said to me that ‘she's going home to freedom and I must go back to my cell for what she has testified.’
Abrie’s story is one of several we uncovered in our investigation - all of them strikingly familiar. We’ve spoken to six other men who claim WIlna Stander accused them of sexually assaulting their children in cases spanning a decade. We don’t name them to protect their children, but three were acquitted…the NPA declined to prosecute two…the 6th man’s conviction was overturned. Their stories are recorded as part of a bigger case launched against CMR North by the Department of Social Development. It’s based on damning public complaints that CMR North broke up families.
LINK: THE DEPARTMENTS REPORT SAYS CMR DON’T LOOK FOR A CHILD WHO NEEDS A FAMILY, BUT LOOK FOR FAMILIES THAT NEED CHILDREN. THEIR FINDINGS WERE THAT 2000 CASE FILES NEED TO BE REVIEWED AND PERHAPS MOST DAMNING OF ALL IS THAT THEY ACCUSED THEM OF CHILD TRAFFICKING BECAUSE THEY UNLAWFULLY REMAllOVED CHILDREN FROM THEIR FAMILIES.
The allegations led the government into withdrawing its funding of CMR North, and stripping it of its “child protection organisation” status. CMR responded by applying for an urgent interdict against the measures - a case that’ll be heard in mid September. Until then, CMR can continue its current work, but can’t take on new cases. (PAUSE) As the person at the centre of so many of the claims and controversies, it was time to meet Wilna Stander. Still practicing in Pretoria, and believing she’s the victim of a witch-hunt, she agreed to meet us with her lawyer present.
Derek: This is the drawing that Megan allegedly made... can you interpret this drawing for us?
W: Die tekening wys dat daar penetrasie is…dit lyk soos 'n kleiner persoon wat op 'n groter persoon lê … dit lyk na 'n kind wat aandui wat 'n penis teken en dan dat daar dinge uit die penis uitkom. Dit teken sy op twee plekke.
Derek: Does it mean her father raped her?
W: Nee dit is nie wat dit beteken nie
Derek: Wilna, Megan says she didn't even draw this? (audio fix)
Stander: Sy’t aan my gese sy het.
Derek: Zwanet raaths says she was told her daughter was raped by her father?
W: Dit is wat die kind aan my weergegee het.
Derek: But the J88 says there is no sign of penetration and still a virgin?
W: Ek kan ongelukkig nie daaroor antwoord nie want dis mediese getuienis
Derek: So you influenced the social worker to tell that she was raped by her father?
W: Ek het nie die maatskaplike werker beinvloed nie ek het vir haar suiwer gesê dis wat die kind vir my sê, en dit gaan by die polisie aangemeld moet word.
Stander denies telling Megan her father raped her.
Stander: Sy’t vir my gesê het privaat in my privaat ingedruk.
Derek: Did you coach Megan and her mother for the court?
Stander: Absolute, glad nie, hoekom sal ek dit wil doen, wat sal my motiwe wees om 'n kind te wil coach. Dit is onmoontlik in drie ure as jy al hierdie tegnieke moet doen, te coach.
CMR North says Wilna Stander wasn’t employed by them at the time and so they’re not involved with Raaths case.

Dr Ronel Aylward is the CEO.
Derek: But a CMR social worker testified in that case?
Ronel: Yes. Only when the case was reopened. Yes. She was called to testify.
Derek: this social worker and Stander said that Abrie Raaths had raped his daughter, analy, and vaginally. What evidence did she have?
Ronel: Probably what the child disclosed during the socio-emotional assessment.
Derek: Wouldn't there have been a medical examination?
Ronel: The examination was positive that there was penetration, vaginal penetration, at least.
Derek: You’re convinced?
R: Well, I know it was positive.
D: Well, the J88 on record says there was no injury found?
R: I have not seen the j88. Let me be honest.
So, despite the medical evidence CMR insists Abrie was grooming her.
Ronel: In 2008 when Wilna did that assessment and she disclosed that to her, we were her voice and we tried to help this child.
Derek: So why did she change her testimony before the sentencing?
Ronel: We do have evidence that the family tried to convince Megan to retract her statements and that they told her that her father was going to die in jail.
Stander believes Megan suffered from what’s called child sexual accommodation syndrome. It typically results in a retraction.
Stander: Druk van familie, geen ondersteuning van ‘n moeder op daardie stadium, en kinders recant. Hulle voel so skuldig. Ek het dit al baie gehad waar kinders net sê, jy weet tussen 22% en 33% van kinders ‘recant’ sexual abuse.
D: Wilna Why didn't you record these sessions?
Stander: Daar is nie wette wat sê dat jy dit moet opneem nie
Derek: Lets forget the law… you've had previous cases in dispute? Surely by now you must be recording cases, why don't you? It’s evidence.
Stander: Ja, nee ja ek hoor wat jy sê
Derek: Did you coach Megan and her mother for the court?
Stander: Absolute glad nie hoekom sal ek dit wil doen wat sal my moet in wees om 'n kind te wil coach dit is in elk geval ontmoontlik.
Claiming social workers are briefed weekly and their reports checked, CMR North are standing by Wilna Stander, sharing her belief that coaching a child is impossible.
D: But in Megan's case, she's been explicit about how she was coached. Her mother was even coached?
R: Yeah, but that did not happen. They were not coached.
Stander, meanwhile, denies any wrongdoing in the cases involving the other 6 men, saying she’s been cleared by the social worker’s statutory body in all complaints lodged against her.
(PAUSE) CMR North only became aware of the 6 complaints from the government’s court papers, but say Stander has worked on over 600 of their cases. CMR North feels blindsided by the government's funding cuts, and were denied the chance to answer the allegations against to them. Claims they categorically deny.
ABRIE’S CASE IS CURRENTLY BEFORE THE CONSTITUTIONAL COURT WHICH WILL DECIDE IF HIS CONVICTIONS AND SENTENCES SHOULD BE OVERTURNED.
Zwanet: I still struggle to forgive myself, and when I look Abrie in the eyes and it's hard.
Megan: I'm 22 years old now, and this all started when I was nine years old. So I'm basically fighting my whole life for this, to show that my father is innocent. 13.08

Show: Title Author Last Updated 11 September 2022 - Carte Blanche HD nombuso@carteblanche.co.za 14 September 2022 Script: For the first 8 years of her life, Megan Raaths and her father Abrie were inseparable... But this drawing of two people having sex changed everything. Megan: I know it's not my fault because I was still young. I feel guilty because my father is sitting in jail. Megan says she didn’t draw the picture some would later claim depicted her being raped by her father.…He was found guilty and sentenced to life in Zonderwater prison, outside Pretoria. (PAUSE) Megan is now 21. Derek: Abrie, it's Derek Watts here from Carte Blanche. Simple question. Did you rape your daughter or molest her in any way? Abrie: No, never. I remember going to court not even worried, I'm not guilty. The justice system will just prove that. At first, Megan’s mother, Zwanet, believed her then husband was guilty. Now, though, she’s fighting for his release. We met her at the Pretoria office of Abrie’s lawyer. Zwanet: Everything just went downhill after the drawing. Did you ever suspect anything untoward between them? No. Never. Zwanet discovered the drawing in Megan’s school bag in 2008. Concerned, she asked the child protection organisation “CMR” - short for “Christelike Maadskaplike Raad”...to give her daughter counseling. CMR was established by Afrikaans churches as a network of social workers 85 years ago, aiming to help families in crisis. Zwanet approached the CMR North branch, which then referred Megan to a social worker in private practice called Wilna Stander. There were several counseling sessions but not one was recorded on tape. Megan: There was this one session that was like 4 hours long without any breaks. She wanted to tell me the difference between a lie and the truth. She used the shoe and the bed as an example. And then I said what she said, the bed is a shoe, and the shoe is a bed, she told me just after that, my father had raped me. Derek: She told you? Megan: Yeah, after she made me confused. That session had dramatic consequences: Zwanet was told her husband Abrie had raped their daughter. She claims to have been informed a medical exam found evidence of sex-related injuries. Zwanet: She just told me Megan was penetrated vag​​inally and anally, and it is the father. I started throwing up, and I started screaming, and saying, ‘No, it can't be. Not Abrie!’ But Zwanet says she felt pressured into helping prosecute Abrie. As soon as I told them every time ‘It's not the father,’ they just started, ‘Mom, if you're not supporting our case, we're going to remove her from your care.’ As the trial drew near, Zwanet alleges that the investigating police officer, a CMR social worker and Stander all told her to help Megan memorize her statements for cross-examination. Zwanet: She's going to work with Megan through the statements that I got from Wilna. And then I must go home and prepare Megan with that. Well, I did it and today I'm very, very, very disappointed in myself that I did that. But I didn't know it was wrong. Megan confirmed her mother’s claims, telling us she was coached on what to say in court. Derek: Zwanet what were some of the things you had to coach her to say? Zwanet: ‘What did he do now? He put his private inside my private’ ‘And how did they feel? A bietjie seer and a bietjie lekker.’ In 2012, Abrie was found guilty and sentenced to 4 life sentences. BUT JUST BEFORE ABRIE WAS SENTENCED – MEGAN TOTALLY RECANTED HER EVIDENCE AND SAID THAT SHE HAD NEVER BEEN RAPED BY HER FATHER Megan: That's when I told my aunt that, ‘My father didn't do anything to me.’ As a result, Abrie was granted a second trial. But, in 2015 he was convicted again. The court accepted the evidence from the social workers who’d relied on Wilna Stander’s assessments. But it was during this trial that Zwanet stumbled upon a crucial piece of evidence: Megan’s medical report or so-called J88.. It found that all was “normal.” However, the doctor who filled in the J88 testified that it was likely that Megan had been raped. Zwanet: When I saw the j88 that was in Abrie's file that showed ‘she's still a virgin.’ Then I was like, ‘What's going on here?’ Abrie was taken to prison. Zwanet and Megan went home to pick up the pieces. It would be 13 years before Megan saw her father again. It was very emotional, and he was the same man that I remembered when I was little. Abrie can’t sit down for an interview. But prisoners are allowed to get phone calls. That first meeting was like talking to a stranger, my daughter that I left, was nine years old. She was half my size, and here comes this beautiful young lady, and she started crying, and she said to me that ‘she's going home to freedom and I must go back to my cell for what she has testified.’ Abrie’s story is one of several we uncovered in our investigation - all of them strikingly familiar. We’ve spoken to six other men who claim WIlna Stander accused them of sexually assaulting their children in cases spanning a decade. We don’t name them to protect their children, but three were acquitted…the NPA declined to prosecute two…the 6th man’s conviction was overturned. Their stories are recorded as part of a bigger case launched against CMR North by the Department of Social Development. It’s based on damning public complaints that CMR North broke up families. LINK: THE DEPARTMENTS REPORT SAYS CMR DON’T LOOK FOR A CHILD WHO NEEDS A FAMILY, BUT LOOK FOR FAMILIES THAT NEED CHILDREN. THEIR FINDINGS WERE THAT 2000 CASE FILES NEED TO BE REVIEWED AND PERHAPS MOST DAMNING OF ALL IS THAT THEY ACCUSED THEM OF CHILD TRAFFICKING BECAUSE THEY UNLAWFULLY REMAllOVED CHILDREN FROM THEIR FAMILIES. The allegations led the government into withdrawing its funding of CMR North, and stripping it of its “child protection organisation” status. CMR responded by applying for an urgent interdict against the measures - a case that’ll be heard in mid September. Until then, CMR can continue its current work, but can’t take on new cases. (PAUSE) As the person at the centre of so many of the claims and controversies, it was time to meet Wilna Stander. Still practicing in Pretoria, and believing she’s the victim of a witch-hunt, she agreed to meet us with her lawyer present. Derek: This is the drawing that Megan allegedly made... can you interpret this drawing for us? W: Die tekening wys dat daar penetrasie is…dit lyk soos 'n kleiner persoon wat op 'n groter persoon lê … dit lyk na 'n kind wat aandui wat 'n penis teken en dan dat daar dinge uit die penis uitkom. Dit teken sy op twee plekke. Derek: Does it mean her father raped her? W: Nee dit is nie wat dit beteken nie Derek: Wilna, Megan says she didn't even draw this? (audio fix) Stander: Sy’t aan my gese sy het. Derek: Zwanet raaths says she was told her daughter was raped by her father? W: Dit is wat die kind aan my weergegee het. Derek: But the J88 says there is no sign of penetration and still a virgin? W: Ek kan ongelukkig nie daaroor antwoord nie want dis mediese getuienis Derek: So you influenced the social worker to tell that she was raped by her father? W: Ek het nie die maatskaplike werker beinvloed nie ek het vir haar suiwer gesê dis wat die kind vir my sê, en dit gaan by die polisie aangemeld moet word. Stander denies telling Megan her father raped her. Stander: Sy’t vir my gesê het privaat in my privaat ingedruk. Derek: Did you coach Megan and her mother for the court? Stander: Absolute, glad nie, hoekom sal ek dit wil doen, wat sal my motiwe wees om 'n kind te wil coach. Dit is onmoontlik in drie ure as jy al hierdie tegnieke moet doen, te coach. CMR North says Wilna Stander wasn’t employed by them at the time and so they’re not involved with Raaths case. Dr Ronel Aylward is the CEO. Derek: But a CMR social worker testified in that case? Ronel: Yes. Only when the case was reopened. Yes. She was called to testify. Derek: this social worker and Stander said that Abrie Raaths had raped his daughter, analy, and vaginally. What evidence did she have? Ronel: Probably what the child disclosed during the socio-emotional assessment. Derek: Wouldn't there have been a medical examination? Ronel: The examination was positive that there was penetration, vaginal penetration, at least. Derek: You’re convinced? R: Well, I know it was positive. D: Well, the J88 on record says there was no injury found? R: I have not seen the j88. Let me be honest. So, despite the medical evidence CMR insists Abrie was grooming her. Ronel: In 2008 when Wilna did that assessment and she disclosed that to her, we were her voice and we tried to help this child. Derek: So why did she change her testimony before the sentencing? Ronel: We do have evidence that the family tried to convince Megan to retract her statements and that they told her that her father was going to die in jail. Stander believes Megan suffered from what’s called child sexual accommodation syndrome. It typically results in a retraction. Stander: Druk van familie, geen ondersteuning van ‘n moeder op daardie stadium, en kinders recant. Hulle voel so skuldig. Ek het dit al baie gehad waar kinders net sê, jy weet tussen 22% en 33% van kinders ‘recant’ sexual abuse. D: Wilna Why didn't you record these sessions? Stander: Daar is nie wette wat sê dat jy dit moet opneem nie Derek: Lets forget the law… you've had previous cases in dispute? Surely by now you must be recording cases, why don't you? It’s evidence. Stander: Ja, nee ja ek hoor wat jy sê Derek: Did you coach Megan and her mother for the court? Stander: Absolute glad nie hoekom sal ek dit wil doen wat sal my moet in wees om 'n kind te wil coach dit is in elk geval ontmoontlik. Claiming social workers are briefed weekly and their reports checked, CMR North are standing by Wilna Stander, sharing her belief that coaching a child is impossible. D: But in Megan's case, she's been explicit about how she was coached. Her mother was even coached? R: Yeah, but that did not happen. They were not coached. Stander, meanwhile, denies any wrongdoing in the cases involving the other 6 men, saying she’s been cleared by the social worker’s statutory body in all complaints lodged against her. (PAUSE) CMR North only became aware of the 6 complaints from the government’s court papers, but say Stander has worked on over 600 of their cases. CMR North feels blindsided by the government's funding cuts, and were denied the chance to answer the allegations against to them. Claims they categorically deny. ABRIE’S CASE IS CURRENTLY BEFORE THE CONSTITUTIONAL COURT WHICH WILL DECIDE IF HIS CONVICTIONS AND SENTENCES SHOULD BE OVERTURNED. Zwanet: I still struggle to forgive myself, and when I look Abrie in the eyes and it's hard. Megan: I'm 22 years old now, and this all started when I was nine years old. So I'm basically fighting my whole life for this, to show that my father is innocent. 13.08

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): 8 Fathers wrongfully accused of sexual assault and rape of their children. Most acquitted but one is in jail for life. At the centre of this drama is a social worker from the CMRN.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: We have an exclusive with CMRN regarding their investigations into the social worker at the heart of this story. We also will speak with the daughter and mother of the man who is in jail for a crime he (allegedly?) did not commit.
metadata.Summary: Willem Abram Raaths was charged of the rape of his own daughter Megan in 2010 and convicted of rape in 2012. Before sentencing but after conviction she recanted her testimony stating that the CMR North social workers involved in her matter had brainwashed and coerced her into testifying against her father. The matter went on Appeal in 2014 before the Pretoria High Court, and The Pretoria high court set aside the convictions and sentence, however the matter went back to the trial court. Megan testified that her father did not rape her and that she was brainwashed and coerced into testifying against her father however once again Raaths was convicted: the rationale was that it was improbable that Social Workers would brainwash or coerce anyone to testify against someone that they did not even know. A forensic investigator then uncovered a further seven matters where the same social workers falsely accused other fathers of rape and molestation of their children in 6 of these cases the accused were acquitted of all charges. In the matter of the State v Gerber the CMR Social Worker was caught out having lied to the court in order to attempt to obtain a conviction of the accused however their was a recording presented to the court of a social interaction analysis which was conducted by the said social worker between the child and her father in the social interaction analysis a recording was taken where the child identified someone other than her father as the perpetrator however the CMR North social worker failed to take this into account and tried to lie to the court by stating that the child did not identify the other person however when confronted with this evidence the social worker refused to answer stating that she would not incriminate herself.
metadata.Further information: In the matter of the state v Basil Jenkins in a Pretoria High Court Judgement the court stated that the coaching of the child witness went to far and as such the accessed ought to have been acquitted on the charges relating to this child. Once more proving the fact that CMR social Workers coach children to testify against their parents. The Department of Social Development were engaged, as they were ALREADY investigating the said social workers on numerous complaints: the resulted in the accreditation of the CMR North social workers and in a damming report which we have which recorded that these social workers may be involved in human trafficking and that all matters involving these social workers must be reviewed. Raaths is currently sitting in Zonderwater prison – his lawyers have requested the con-court to overturn the judgement and set aside his sentence, and this decision may come in August roughly – but no one can say for sure. There is another man also sitting in Zonderwater, Basil Jenkins whose conviction was overturned because the social worker was found to be lying. In paragraph 29 of the Judgement it is stated that The only inference that can be made is that she was trained to the extent only to remember certain things and therefore her evidence should be rejected and the accused can be acquitted on the charges relating to this witness. Of the other 7 case studies: Name Year Conviction/acquittal Contact detail Evidence against them Willing to be interviewed by CB? Willem Raaths 2010 case, Case was dismissed and reheard 2012 case Convicted in 2012, subsequent appeals failed Currently at Zonderwater prison Only testimony from Megan Raaths Social Workers including Stander and dr Grabe part of CMR team Yes Basil Jenkins 2020 Judgement overturned conviction The court of appeal found that the child was coached, and accused ought to be acquitted. Hendrik van schalkwyk 55/08/201 ? Charges formally withdrawn after report proving no sexual violation furnished to high court child returned to parents care after cmr removed from the case Stander concluded assessment, no recording of it. A second forensic assessment was done as ordered by Judge Fabricius. It concluded no sexual violation occurred. Henrik Gerber 2011 Acquitted on all charges Matter referred to Stander by Van Schalkwyk. Concluded rape during 3, 3 hour assessment, no recording of it. The child tried to explain that someone else sexually violated her, but Stander interrupted her, and was adamant that it was her father. The session was recorded by the father. During cross-examination, this was put to stander [PG 17 typed record]. The judge was scathing of the Social Workers conduct saying she cannot assess children as she doesn’t have the qualifications. She also did not include representatives for the child during the sessions. Jonathan Maritz 2011 Acquittal on all charges Matter referred to Stander by Van Schalkwyk. Concluded rape during 3, 3 hour assessment, no recording of it. Standers version was rejected. Douglas ven den Heever 2019 Nolle Prosequi Only standers report Janus Prins 2020 No charges laid due to the confrontation of the Social Worker currently in employ of CMR North Stander was confronted by the family on her initial report Oct 2020, she then revised her report, apologized to the family for making false statements about the children alleging the father raped them, and then made a new report, removing all allegations against the father. Then illegally backdated the report to Sept 2020. ? People to interview: 1. Psychologist Lancia van der Merwe: there was no critical thinking by stander, protocols were not followed and her findings were outside of professional expertise. The HPCSA confirmed Stander is not registered as a Psychologist, and therefore cannot conduct psychometric assessments. She can’t interpret sketches made by children. Stander misled the court about her authority. Stander was found incompetent, irregular and improper. 2. Department of social development who have defunded and deregistered ?! CMR NW: Based on a report [PLEASE SEND REPORT AND POTENTIALLY CITE THEIR FINDINGS]. CMR went to court to fight the DSD : [EXPLAIN WHAT HAPPENED] People to confront: 1. CMR NW 2. Wilna Stander 3. Margaritet Van Schalkwyk 4. Dr Susana Johanna Grabe UPDATE: So when we spoke last we were having a conversation about motive: So this is what I've been able to establish. The average adoption costs R40,000 according to the department, when they are meant to be free, so they feel that's an incentive in order for social workers to try take children away or pursue children and have them adopted. This is what we know Letitia did, but obviously she went further and even tried to offer multiple parents the same child. The department talks about this and confirms this in a parliamentary monitoring meeting. But we already know it. So Dominee Daniel van Rensburg who worked with the CMR and its social workers, and he says he saw that they are paid per the cases. He wants to meet with my later and chat about this and whether he'll speak. We know that the department and CMR have an agreement in place whereby in exchange for the CMR doing a job that the department is meant to do, they are paid per case. So obviously the more cases, the more money. We know that on average CMRN (CMR-NORTHWEST) got R7 million on average in subsidies from the government in the past three years, which has increased dramatically over the years. In 2017 it was only 3.4 million. The subsidies can be explained by the department of social development - and they said "The CMR get paid per child intake from the Department of Social Development, so while adoption is an incentive, they need to have high intake levels in order to obtain subsidies." This is why the report by SD literally says: They are looking for a family that needs a child, not a child that needs a family. Which is pretty damning. I have a leaked document from CMRs finances: staff expenses are 78% of their expenses!!! SO according to the department the motive is clear - they are upping their intakes to get more children, so that they can get more subsidies.
